analysis.bootstrap_method: independent game-level nonparametric bootstrap with replacement
analysis.difference_in_differences_resampling: independently resample every game-level sample entering each corrected-versus-original or corrected-4x4-versus-corrected-3x3 contrast

rules_in_precedence_order: unresolved if a required sample has fewer than 25 games or a required interval is unavailable
persists if corrected 100k-minus-30k is positive and its 95% interval is entirely at or above zero
reverses if corrected 100k-minus-30k is negative and its 95% interval is entirely at or below zero
stabilizes if the corrected primary point difference is within 0.03 in absolute value

analysis.regenerated_magnitude_comparison: absolute regenerated-minus-original effect minus absolute terminal-rescore-minus-original effect; independently resample regenerated games and paired historical outcomes
analysis.terminal_rescore_direct_effect_bootstrap: paired game-level resampling of each historical trajectory's original and terminal-rescored outcome

production_head_lock_policy: on first production start after the locked implementation is committed, record exact clean HEAD in results/production/production-head-lock.json; every start/resume must match it
rerun_command_templates: tmux new-session -d -s heitan-112-10k "cd '$REPO_ROOT' && caffeinate -i env HEITAN112_CAFFEINATE=1 HEITAN112_RUNNER_ID='$HEITAN112_RUNNER_ID' LUDII_JAR='$LUDII_JAR' python3 experiments/issue-112/scripts/run_experiments.py production --budget 10000"

rules_in_precedence_order: unresolved if any primary budget has fewer than 25 validated games or a required estimate is unavailable
non-monotonic if adjacent deltas have opposite signs and both absolute deltas exceed 0.03
stable / converged-looking if both adjacent absolute deltas are at most 0.03
directionally stabilizing if adjacent deltas have the same sign, the later absolute delta is smaller, and it is at most 0.07
monotonic but unresolved if adjacent deltas have the same non-zero sign and no earlier rule applies
stability_classification.source: Issue #108 thresholds, with the Issue #112-requested monotonic-but-unresolved category added before production

supply_diagnostics.final_secured_supply_count_definition: number of Supply points in state 3 or 4 at natural game end
supply_diagnostics.first_supply_securing_definition: first Heitan-turn end at which any Supply has state 3 or 4
supply_diagnostics.placement_share_definition: Supply or Objective placements divided by all 72 placements

trial_normalization.third_party_revalidation_limitation: raw SHA-256 is generation-time evidence only; third-party replay depends on the published normalized trial
